name: Drandlesticks (9-10)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination

disable: DC 30 Thievery check to safely clear the path.

items.name: Stick
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks on to the Drandlesticks

---
Effect The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 30 Acrobatics check check or take 1d4+11 piercing, 2d6 precision, and 2d4 persistent bleed damage. A creature taking persistent bleed damage from the Drandlesticks takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speed.

Additionally, a creature damaged by the Drandlesticks is targeted by a Command spell (DC 28 Will save save) with orders to release everything it's holding; if the creature fails the save and drops what it's holding, there is a 50% chance that the high winds blow the object or objects off the edge of the Colossus.

text: Enchanted caltrops blend in with the surrounding masonry.
